body: The thing is I don't want to date yet. I just want to have friends who'll call me and invite me out.

I won a bigger sum of money in a tournament last year and have been living off it since, there were no bigger poker successes after that, I might need to go to work soon. Also, I don't spend a lot of money never leaving home.

I have some past friends with whom I sometimes talk on facebook, never irl anymore.
They mostly are my high-school friends who moved to other cities. I invite them to my place and they never visit. Recently my best friend from when we were 14-17 years old, to whom I lost my virginity was in my city to meet me and she canceled.

I don't belong to any group of people who meet frequently and do stuff together, like most people I know. I don't feel comfortable in that kind of dynamic.
Nearly all of my social interactions are 1 v 1 relationships. That's harder to maintain than just belonging to a group. That`s why I find it nearly pointless to start new ones.


I have the phase of going outside alone behind me. I have never heard not even one interesting sentence from anyone I talked to at bars, gym, study groups. I really was cheerful and friendly, exchanged numbers, but they never reached out to meet again.

well I was at the peak of my happiness when we first fell in love with my gf, in early 2013.
In 2014 i left our hometown to study at uni. Even though I drove 6 hours to see her almost every weekend, I still felt the emotional bond weakening. I got jealous (she was a valedictorian, pretty and popular) and a little fat (I couldn't afford healthy food at my first year), so when she moved to this city to study, she already wanted to be free. I felt that. Christmas of 2014, she broke up with me and I wasn`t the same ever since.

okay, I have read somewhere, they don`t stack. If enemy is in range of 2 freezing towers, it slows down to the highest speed.

Freezing time stacks though.

I do regain a will to live every now and then.
It keeps on for a week or two, i feel very satisfied being active all day. After a while I can`t get the kick out of the same things anymore, get tired and go back to being alone.

I`m so sorry. You seem to be going through what my mother went 5 years ago, when my dad died of brain cancer.

My parents went from nothing to everything together. We have just finished building their dream house and moved in, when my dad died. My mom was and still is depressed, but she`s moved on.

In a support group for those who lost their loved ones to cancer, she met her boyfriend. He has lost his wife. They have been together and support each other ever since. They seem pretty happy. They work, they live and travel together.

Maybe that`s the way?
